√vyac 'extend'
present: [3.] viviktás etc. vivyacanta -- [6.] vicati 
perfect: vivyāca vivyáktha viveca? vivicus 
[aorist: vicyāt avyāci avivyacat avyacīt avyācīt vyaciṣyati vyacitā vicitā vicita vicitvā vevic- vāvyac- vivyaciṣa- vyācaya- ]
derivatives: vyácas vyáciṣṭha V.B. vī́ci? V. 
Has a very suspicious likeness to √añc, ac + vi.

√vyath 'waver'
present: [1.] vyáthate etc. V.+ vyáthati etc. E.+ 
perfect: vivyathe E.+ vivyathus 
aorist: [1.] avyathi avyāthi -- [3.] vivyathas -- [5.] vyathiṣi etc. AV.+ vyathiṣat 
[future: vyathiṣyate vyathitā ]
verbal: vyathitá AV.+ vyathiṣyai 
secondary: intensive: vāvyath- -- desiderative: vivyathiṣa- -- causative: vyatháyati etc. V.+ vyathayīs vyathyate 
derivatives: vyathā B.+ vyathaka C. -vyathya V.B. vyathana E.+ vyáthi V. vyathí? AV. vyáthis RV. -vyātha B. vithurá V.B.S. vyathayitṛ C. -vyathin C.

√vyadh 'pierce'
present: [4.] vídhyati etc. V.+ vídhyate 
perfect: vivyādha B.+ vivyadhus vividhus vividhvā́ṅs vivyadhe 
aorist: [1.] vidhyāt -- [3.] avīvidhat avivyadhat -- [4.] vyātsīs 
future: [1.] vetsyati vetsyate vyatsyati -- [2.] veddhā vyaddhā 
verbal: viddhá V.+ veddhum viddhvā -vidhya E.+ -vídhe passive: vidhyate -- intensive: vāvyadh- vevidh- -- desiderative: vivyatsati -- causative: vyādhayati vyadhayati vedhayati etc. 
derivatives: -vidh V.+ -vidhya E. vedha E.+ vedhaka E.+ vedhin E.+ vedhya C. vyadha C. vyadhya C. vyādha AV.+ vyādhin AV.B. -vyādhyà AV. vedhana E.+ vyadhana AV.C. veddhavya U.+ veddhṛ E.+ -vedhima C. vyadhvará? AV.

√vyay 'expend'
present: [1.] vyayati vyayate etc. 
[perfect: vavyāya vavyaye etc. ]
verbal: vyayita 
Is only a conjugation of √i + vi, or denominative of vyaya.

present: vyáyati vyáyate etc. V.+ 
perfect: vivyathus vivyé etc. vivyāya vivyayitha etc. -vyayā́ṃ cakāra 
aorist: [1.] vīyāt -- [2.] ávyat etc. avyata etc. -- [4.] avyāsta vyāsīṣṭa -- [6.] avyāsīt

secondary: passive: vīyáte -- intensive: vāvyā- vevī- -- desiderative: vivyāsa- -- causative: vyāyaya-
